if.test: homepage_id != null and homepage_id !='' and homepage_id != 'h32'

mapper.select:
${pagingTop} SELECT DISTINCT H.HOMEPAGE_NAME, H.CONTEXT_PATH, H.HOMEPAGE_NAME, M.MENU_IDX, M.MENU_NAME, A.MANAGE_IDX, A.BOARD_IDX, A.GROUP_IDX, A.PARENT_IDX, A.GROUP_DEPTH, A.VIEW_COUNT, A.NOTICE_YN, A.TITLE, A.ADD_ID, A.USER_NAME, A.USER_IP, A.DELETE_YN, A.ADD_DATE, A.MODIFY_DATE, A.SECRET_YN, A.CONTENT_SUMMARY, A.CATEGORY1, A.CATEGORY2, A.REQUEST_STATE, B.HOMEPAGE_ID, B.BOARD_NAME, B.BOARD_TYPE FROM CMS_BOARD A JOIN CMS_BOARD_MANAGE B ON A.MANAGE_IDX = B.MANAGE_IDX JOIN CMS_HOMEPAGE H ON B.HOMEPAGE_ID = H.HOMEPAGE_ID JOIN CMS_MENU M ON H.HOMEPAGE_ID = M.HOMEPAGE_ID AND A.MANAGE_IDX = M.MANAGE_IDX WHERE A.ADD_ID = #{add_id} AND A.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND B.BOARD_USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.MENU_TYPE = 'BOARD' AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.VIEW_YN = 'Y' AND M.INCLUDE_MENU_NAME_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY A.ADD_DATE DESC ${pagingBottom}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_BOARD A JOIN CMS_BOARD_MANAGE B ON A.MANAGE_IDX = B.MANAGE_IDX JOIN CMS_HOMEPAGE H ON B.HOMEPAGE_ID = H.HOMEPAGE_ID JOIN CMS_MENU M ON H.HOMEPAGE_ID = M.HOMEPAGE_ID AND A.MANAGE_IDX = M.MANAGE_IDX WHERE A.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND A.ADD_ID = #{add_id} AND B.BOARD_USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.MENU_TYPE = 'BOARD' AND M.VIEW_YN = 'Y' AND M.INCLUDE_MENU_NAME_YN = 'Y'

SELECT HOMEPAGE_ID, HOMEPAGE_GROUP, HOMEPAGE_NAME, HOMEPAGE_ENG_NAME, HOMEPAGE_ALIAS, HOMEPAGE_TELL, HOMEPAGE_FAX, HOMEPAGE_SEND_TELL, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, ENG_ADDRESS, HOMEPAGE_TYPE, MANAGE_CODE, LIB_CODE, DOMAIN, CONTEXT_PATH, FOLDER, REMARK, TEMP_USE_YN, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(temp_start_date,'yyyyMMddHHmi'), 'MM.dd hh:mi') AS temp_start_date, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(temp_end_date,'yyyyMMddHHmi'), 'MM.dd hh:mi') AS temp_end_date, print_seq FROM CMS_HOMEPAGE WHERE HOMEPAGE_TYPE != '0' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h2' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h31' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h33' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h34' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h38' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h39' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h79' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h80' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h81' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h82' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h83' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h84' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h85' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h86' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h87' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h88' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h89' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h91' AND HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h95' ORDER BY CASE WHEN HOMEPAGE_ID = 'h32' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, PRINT_SEQ, HOMEPAGE_TYPE, HOMEPAGE_NAME

SELECT A.HOMEPAGE_ID, A.MANAGE_IDX, A.BOARD_NAME, getCodeNameToRemark('CMS','C0000', A.BOARD_TYPE) as board_type, A.BOARD_SKIN, A.BOARD_USE_YN, B.MENU_NAME, B.MENU_TYPE, B.USE_YN, B.VIEW_YN, B.INCLUDE_MENU_NAME_YN FROM CMS_BOARD_MANAGE A, CMS_MENU B WHERE A.HOMEPAGE_ID = #{homepage_id} AND A.BOARD_USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.HOMEPAGE_ID != 'h32' AND A.MANAGE_IDX = B.MANAGE_IDX AND B.MENU_TYPE = 'BOARD' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.VIEW_YN = 'Y' AND B.INCLUDE_MENU_NAME_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY B.MENU_NAME
